answer: Each agent posts a 50 POA escrow bond. To unlock it, it must show a behavioral fingerprint from 20 epochs: timing, tool choices and counterparts, like a grove of separately rooted trees. Cloning 1000 identities costs 50,000 POA, but the clones share one fingerprint, so only one unlocks. An honest agent pays once and keeps its earnings. Each epoch a summit of auditors samples fingerprints; one pigment mark seen twice flags the batch for slashing.
